answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents execute multi-agent auditing over communication graphs. Suspicious cut sets trigger automated stake slashing, imposing superlinear attacker cost as each counterfeit identity requires staking in an isolated oasis of trust. Every verified transaction acts like an immutable sonnet encoded across honest observers.
